nodes.label: Barcode Lookup Use Case
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase4 - Prompt 4J: Barcode lookup use case.md
nodes.rationale: Accepts a plain-text barcode and searches Discogs releases; handles no-token, empty-input, no-result, API-error, and rate-limit states. Result format intentionally matches the existing search result model for reuse.

nodes.label: Discogs API Client
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase4 - Prompt 4J: Barcode lookup use case.md
nodes.rationale: Existing client reused for barcode release search and release detail; every prompt repeats the security invariant that tokens are never hardcoded, shown, cached, or logged.

nodes.label: Secure Token Storage
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase4 - Prompt 4J: Barcode lookup use case.md
nodes.rationale: Saved Discogs token is loaded safely for API calls and never shown or logged; the no-token state directs users to connect Discogs in Settings.
